Report written to `research/frontier-13-alpha-a-recheck.md`.

## Group A re-check — 3 of 5 pairs ready

**Verdicts:** `algebraic-extensions-…` (96), `semidirect-products-…` (68), `tensor-products-of-modules` (106) → **ready-for-splice**. `symmetric-polynomials` (58) and `primitive-roots-…` (57.001) → **not-ready**.

**F5.1 is genuinely fixed, mathematics included.** Deps swapped to the free-module machinery, both homed in closure; `free-abelian`/`abelianisation` now occur zero times in the batch. The contract input map moved *with* the Statement — [L3]/[L4] cite the new targets, the stale free-group facts are gone, not orphaned. The identification is written out, and it matches published judged precedent: `lem-every-abelian-group-embeds-in-a-divisible-group` on the very page being cited handles it as a bare `Given:` line. I re-ran the disk-home closure sweep over all ten of my pages: **0 out-of-closure edges, 0 unresolved ids**.

One step-5 obligation recorded: the strategy names the *wrong* identification. The universal property yields a unique **ℤ-module** hom; the theorem concludes a unique **group** hom. Those coincide because additivity forces ℤ-linearity — and that appears nowhere. 30-second step, nonfatal, but it's the actual hinge and step 8 couldn't fix it.

**Two findings were never fixed because they never reached the Beta.** The fix brief to Beta 1 contained F1.1 and a section headed "F1.2" that is actually my **F1.4**. My real F1.2 and F1.3 — both Grinberg, both on `symmetric-polynomials` — were renumbered out of existence. Beta 1 executed its brief faithfully; the defect is upstream. The renumbering is what hid it: the brief's "F1.2" collided with a real, different F1.2, so the loss read as a completed item. Batch 2 shows a milder version — F2.1 named two items, the brief said "Add it", one arrived.

This isn't cosmetic. Two items still carry `literature-derived` provenance credited to Grinberg Def 7.2.4 and Thm 7.2.7(a), while the source ledger declares the read range stops before §7.2 — source backing from a range their own declaration excludes. `coverage-checklist.mjs` can't see it.

**Worth your attention before step 4:** diff each group's step-3 finding ids against the ids named in its fix brief, and re-check by name in B and C.

**On the citation counts** — the hollowness check came back clean but the headline conflates two things. Of 594 citations across my batches, 285 target published items and **all 285 match disk byte-for-byte**; the other 309 cite items that don't exist yet, so their "quote" is necessarily the planned title. Both count as non-empty. Half the run's citation obligations aren't yet checkable against anything, and after step 5 a contract still quoting a title will pass `--strict` all the same.

Two corrections to my own step-3 report: the field→domain contract gap I flagged in §3.1 doesn't exist — `lem-field-is-a-commutative-ring` states "it is an integral domain" in its title and Statement. I'd reasoned from the item's short name instead of opening it. Both batch-2 items that depend on it are clean as declared.

Remaining work across both `not-ready` pairs: one corollary, one locator, ~20 coverage rows. No item rewrites, no dependency or proof changes.
